name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central government direct income support transferring funds directly into bank accounts of farmer families for procuring agriculture inputs.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families owning cultivable land across all states.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Lowest premium (1.5% - 2%) with comprehensive crop risk cover
description: Comprehensive insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Collateral-free loan up to ₹1.6 Lakh (up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% interest)
description: Timely credit for cultivating crops, post-harvest expenses, and farm asset maintenance at subsidized interest rates.
eligibility: Individual/joint cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and Self Help Groups.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
benefit: Up to 55% subsidy for small farmers on Drip/Sprinkler systems
description: Enhances water use efficiency at farm level through micro-irrigation technologies, reducing water wastage and boosting yield.
eligibility: All landholding farmers with assured irrigation source.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40% to 50% subsidy on tractors, power tillers, and harvesters
description: Increases reach of farm mechanization to small and marginal farmers and promotes custom hiring centers in low-mechanized regions.
eligibility: Small/marginal farmers, women farmers, and SC/ST farmers with agricultural land.

name: PM KUSUM (Solar Irrigation Pump Scheme)
benefit: 60% government subsidy on standalone solar agriculture pumps
description: De-dieselization of farm sector by replacing diesel irrigation pumps with off-grid solar pumps and solarizing grid-connected tubewells.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, and water user associations.

name: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
description: Flagship scheme of West Bengal providing bi-annual financial assistance for agricultural inputs and grant in case of farmer's demise.
eligibility: All recorded cultivators, patta holders, and registered bargadars (sharecroppers).

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
description: Top-up financial assistance provided by Maharashtra Government alongside central PM-Kisan to boost rural farmer income.
eligibility: Active registered beneficiaries of PM-Kisan owning land in Maharashtra.

name: Krishi Bhagya Scheme
benefit: Up to 80% subsidy for farm ponds (Krishi Honda) & polythene mulching
description: Empowers rain-dependent farmers by conserving rainwater in farm ponds and adopting diesel/solar lifting pumps with micro-irrigation.
eligibility: Rain-fed agricultural landholders in drought-prone taluks of Karnataka.

name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
benefit: ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 for Kharif + ₹5,000 for Rabi)
description: Pioneering farm investment support scheme giving financial aid for procuring seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and field operations.
eligibility: Land-owning farmers registered with pattadar passbooks in Telangana.

name: Rajasthan Tarbandi Yojana (Boundary Fencing)
benefit: 50% subsidy up to ₹40,000 for barbed wire fencing
description: Helps farmers construct protective wire boundaries around agricultural plots to prevent crop destruction by stray animals and blue bulls.
eligibility: Farmers of Rajasthan owning a minimum of 1.5 hectares of cultivable land.

name: Paani Bachao Paise Kamao Scheme
benefit: Direct cash incentive of ₹4 per kilowatt-hour of saved electricity
description: Unique incentive initiative rewarding tubewell farmers with direct bank cash for conserving groundwater and electricity during paddy season.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab having agricultural power connections with installed digital meters.
